headword: {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}

definitions.explanation: An entrance examination for students seeking to transfer into a university or school at a year other than the first. In Japan, this typically allows students from junior colleges or technical colleges to enter the third year of a four-year university.

examples.japanese: {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started preparing for the transfer examination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{短大|たんだい}→短大：28812_tandai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{四年制大学|よねんせいだいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧{三年次|さんねんじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}した→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧。
examples.english: After graduating from junior college, I passed the transfer exam and enrolled as a third-year student at a four-year university.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{編入|へんにゅう}→編入：13887_hennyuu⟧ (transfer, incorporation) and ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (examination). A specific type of entrance exam for mid-program admission.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take a transfer exam
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}する→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧: to pass a transfer exam
- {編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過去問|かこもん}: past transfer exam questions
- {三年次|さんねんじ}{編入試験|へんにゅうしけん}: third-year transfer exam

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{編入生|へんにゅうせい}→編入生：22044_hennyuusei⟧: transfer student — the student who passes this exam
- ⟦{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}→入学試験：09258_nyuugakushiken⟧: entrance examination — the standard first-year admission exam
- {推薦入試|すいせんにゅうし}: recommendation-based admission — another alternative admission pathway

USAGE:
The format varies by university but often includes a written exam in the student's field, an English exam, and an interview. Competition can be intense at top universities.
